headline: School Committee to review PK-8 and 9-12 handbooks for approval, plus FY27 budget update.
summary: The meeting covers approval of the PK-8 and 9-12 handbooks, an FY27 budget update including HR and staffing, and updates on Pathways Programming, School Choice, and Opening of School Preparation. The Finance Subcommittee will also give an update.
items: PK-8 Handbook (part I, part II, part III) and memo - Approval
9-12 Handbook (part I, part II, part III) and memo - Approval
FY27 Budget Update (part I, part II, part III) including HR and staffing
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
